```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120)
library(magreport)
run <- params$run
has <- function(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0
```

Report generated from `` `r params$results_dir` `` with the
[magreport](https://github.com/AntonioPuriel/magreport) R package.

## Summary

```{r summary}
lines <- character()

if (has(run$mapping)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **Samples:** %d", nrow(run$mapping)))
}
if (has(run$assembly)) {
  kept <- run$assembly[nrow(run$assembly), , drop = FALSE]
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **Assembly:** %s contigs, %.1f Mb, N50 %s bp",
    format(kept$n_contigs, big.mark = ","),
    kept$total_length / 1e6,
    format(kept$n50, big.mark = ",")
  ))
}
if (has(run$bins)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **Bins:** %d from %s",
                            nrow(run$bins),
                            paste(sort(unique(run$bins$binner)), collapse = ", ")))
}
if (has(run$mags)) {
  counts <- count_quality(run$mags)
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **MAGs assessed:** %d (%s)",
    nrow(run$mags),
    paste(sprintf("%d %s", counts$n, counts$quality), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}
if (has(run$catalog)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **Gene catalog:** %s non-redundant genes from %s genes called",
    format(run$catalog$catalog_genes, big.mark = ","),
    format(run$catalog$genes_called, big.mark = ",")
  ))
}
if (has(run$singlem)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **SingleM:** profiles of %d samples from the reads",
                            length(unique(run$singlem$sample))))
}

knitr::asis_output(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

## Read mapping

```{r mapping, eval = has(run$mapping)}
plot_mapping_rates(run$mapping)
```

```{r mapping-table, eval = has(run$mapping)}
knitr::kable(run$mapping, caption = "Reads and alignment rate per sample")
```

```{r no-mapping, eval = !has(run$mapping)}
knitr::asis_output("_No mapping summary found._")
```

```{r assembly, eval = has(run$assembly)}
knitr::kable(run$assembly, caption = "Contigs before and after length filtering")
```

```{r no-assembly, eval = !has(run$assembly)}
knitr::asis_output("_No assembly statistics found._")
```

## Bins

```{r bins, eval = has(run$bins)}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(table(binner = run$bins$binner)),
  col.names = c("Binner", "Bins"),
  caption = "Bins per binner"
)
```

## MAG quality

```{r quality-plot, eval = has(run$mags)}
plot_mag_quality(run$mags, facet_by = if (length(unique(run$mags$binner)) > 1) "binner" else NULL)
```

```{r quality-counts, eval = has(run$mags)}
knitr::kable(count_quality(run$mags, by = "binner"),
             caption = "MAGs per quality category (MIMAG thresholds)")
```

```{r quality-table, eval = has(run$mags)}
mags <- run$mags[order(-run$mags$completeness), ]
knitr::kable(
  utils::head(mags, 25),
  row.names = FALSE,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "MAGs, best completeness first (up to 25 shown)"
)
```

```{r no-mags, eval = !has(run$mags)}
knitr::asis_output("_No CheckM2 results found: run the pipeline without --skip_checkm2._")
```

## Taxonomy

```{r taxonomy, eval = has(run$mags) && "phylum" %in% names(run$mags) && !all(is.na(run$mags$phylum))}
plot_taxonomy(run$mags, rank = "phylum", fill_by = "quality")
```

```{r no-taxonomy, eval = !(has(run$mags) && "phylum" %in% names(run$mags) && !all(is.na(run$mags$phylum)))}
knitr::asis_output("_No taxonomy available: run the pipeline with --gtdbtk_db to classify the MAGs._")
```

## Functional annotation

```{r annotation, eval = has(run$annotation)}
knitr::kable(run$annotation, digits = 1,
             caption = "Genes called, annotated and distinct KEGG orthologues per MAG")
```

```{r pathways, eval = has(run$kos), fig.height = 3 + 0.35 * length(unique(run$kos$bin))}
plot_pathway_presence(run$kos, mags = run$mags)
```

```{r no-function, eval = !has(run$kos)}
knitr::asis_output("_No functional annotation found: run the pipeline with --eggnog_db._")
```

## Community profile

The whole community, without binning: the genes of every contig gathered in a
non-redundant catalog, with their abundance (TPM) in each sample, their
taxonomy (CAT) and function (eggNOG, CANT-HYD), and the profile of the reads
with SingleM, which needs no assembly.

```{r community-setup, include = FALSE}
has_community <- has(run$catalog) || has(run$profile_stats) ||
  has(run$contig_taxonomy) || has(run$singlem)
n_samples <- length(unique(c(run$contig_taxonomy$sample, run$singlem$sample,
                             run$profile_stats$sample)))
wide <- max(8, 4 + 0.22 * n_samples)
```

```{r catalog, eval = has(run$catalog)}
knitr::kable(run$catalog, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Genes called on the contigs and genes in the catalog")
```

```{r annotation-fraction, eval = has(run$profile_stats)}
plot_annotation_fraction(run$profile_stats)
```

```{r cat-phylum, eval = has(run$contig_taxonomy), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$contig_taxonomy, rank = "phylum")
```

```{r cat-genus, eval = has(run$contig_taxonomy), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$contig_taxonomy, rank = "genus", top = 12)
```

```{r singlem-phylum, eval = has(run$singlem), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$singlem, rank = "phylum")
```

```{r singlem-genus, eval = has(run$singlem), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 5.5}
plot_community(run$singlem, rank = "genus", top = 12)
```

```{r comparison, eval = has(run$contig_taxonomy) && has(run$singlem), fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 6}
plot_profile_comparison(run$contig_taxonomy, run$singlem, rank = "phylum")
plot_profile_comparison(run$contig_taxonomy, run$singlem, rank = "genus")
```

```{r canthyd-heatmap, eval = has(run$contig_canthyd), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 2 + 0.25 * length(unique(run$contig_canthyd$feature))}
plot_feature_heatmap(run$contig_canthyd, top = 40)
```

```{r ko-heatmap, eval = has(run$contig_kos) && any(hydrocarbon_kos()$ko %in% run$contig_kos$feature), fig.width = wide, fig.height = 7}
plot_feature_heatmap(run$contig_kos, features = hydrocarbon_kos())
```

```{r no-community, eval = !has_community}
knitr::asis_output(paste(
  "_No community profile found: run mag-pipeline 2.0 with --workflow contigs",
  "or both (gene catalog, CAT with --cat_db) and --singlem_db._"
))
```
